title: Receive
text: Receive messages, 1 input, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Initial value} sets initial data value; {Use internal queue} selects to use an internal queue, {Overwrite the oldest element if queue is full} sets the queue overwriting policy, {Queue length} sets the length of the message queue, {Queue type} sets the message queue sorting, {Priority order} sets the message queue, {Show receive status} shows whether a message was received, {Value source when queue is empty} sets the value source for empty queue Hold last and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the time interval between samples. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_S
ports.summary: Show whether a message was received scalar

params.name: Use internal queue
params.values: Select to use an internal queue on (default for SimEvents ® ) | off (default for Simulink ® )

params.name: Overwrite the oldest element if queue is full
params.values: Specify queue overwriting policy on (default for Simulink) | off (default for SimEvents)

params.name: Queue length
params.values: Specify the length of the message queue 16 (default) | scalar

params.name: Queue type
params.values: Specify message queue sorting policy FIFO (default) | LIFO | Priority

params.name: Priority order
params.values: Specify message queue priority Ascending (default) | Descending

params.name: Show receive status
params.values: Show whether a message was received off (default) | on

params.name: Initial value
params.values: Set initial data value [](unspecified) (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Value source when queue is empty
params.values: Value source for empty queue Hold last value (default) | Use initial value

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Specify the time interval between samples -1 (default) | scalar
